basic_info.description: Welcome to 35 Commonwealth, where timeless San Francisco architecture meets contemporary luxury. Set on one of Jordan Park's rare wide parcels, this fully detached estate offers nearly 4,800 sq.ft. across four levels on a 3,998 sq.ft. lot. Flooded with natural light, the main level is designed for grand entertaining and everyday ease, featuring a formal living room with fireplace, gracious dining room, and spacious chef's kitchen with stainless appliances. A bright sunroom/family area flows to a deck ideal for al fresco dining with steps to a lower deck and landscaped backyard. Upstairs, the private level offers three bedrooms and three baths, including a serene primary suite with private balcony, multiple walk-in closets, and spa-inspired bath. A secondary suite with walk-in closet, third bedroom, and laundry complete this floor. The top level adds versatility with a family/media room, fourth bedroom, full bath, and office. Outdoors, a rare city luxury awaits: a private basketball/sport court doubling as a generous patio, plus a two-car garage and abundant storage. Enjoy a location defined by neighborhood charm and convenience, moments from Sacramento Street, Laurel Village, the Presidio, excellent schools, and commuter access.
